ui.title: My baby
ui.card_wait: Your baby hasn't written yet today… soon 👀
ui.share_sub: As a photo or a message-by-message video. Let your friends see it too 💛
ui.share_text: My baby isn't born yet, but texts me 💛 Anacan
ui.hook: My baby isn't born yet… but texts me.
ui.about: Just for fun: Anacan writes the messages to match your baby's week.
ui.care_text: Share this with your doctor too, mum. Every question matters 💛

openers: Mum, can I tell you something? 💛
notifications: You won't believe what I want to tell you today! 💛

love: I haven't seen you yet, but I already love you so much 🥰
I may be the size of a {fruit}, but my heart is full of you 💛
how: Great! It's warm and cosy in here 😌
I'm good, mum. I grew a little more today 🌱
So good! I'm listening to your heartbeat 💓
size: Right now I'm about the size of a {fruit} 😄
I'm in week {week} and growing a little every day 🌱
kick_early: I'm already wiggling, but I'm still so tiny you won't feel it 🤭
I'm doing little somersaults in here 🤸 You'll feel them soon!
kick: Did you feel that? That was me 🦶
I danced today, did you feel it? 💃
That kick was me saying hi 👋🦶
hear_early: My ears are still getting ready, but I'll hear you soon 👂
Let me grow a little more, then I'll hear your voice 🥰
hear: I can hear you, mum! Talk to me again 🥰
Your voice is my favourite music 🎶
Sing me a song and I'll listen 🎵
food: Whatever you eat, I get a taste too 😋
Shall we have some fruit today? 🍎
Mmm, that was yummy! A bit more? 😄
sleep: I want to sleep too 😴 Let's rest together
When you lie down, I relax too 😌
Sorry if I dance at night 🙈
dad: Say hi to dad for me! 👋
I love it when dad talks to your bump 🥰
meet: {weeks_left} more weeks and then we meet! 🤗
I want to see you too! Let me grow a bit more 🌱
It won't be long until we meet 💛
meet_soon: Not long now, mum! I'm getting ready too 🤗
Soon I'll be in your arms 💛
name: What will you call me? 😊 Pick a lovely name!
Any name will sound lovely in your voice 💛
hello: Hiii! I was waiting for you 💛
thanks: Thank you for carrying me around 💛
generic: Hmm… I'll ask about that when I'm bigger 😄
I'm still little, but I loved that 😄
care: I love you so much, mum 💛

weekly.4: Mum, I'm only the size of a poppy seed, but I have big plans 🌱
weekly.5: My heart started beating! Thump-thump… can you hear it? 💓
weekly.6: My nose is forming this week 👃 I'm sure I'll love how you smell!
weekly.7: My hands look like tiny paddles 🤲 I can't clap yet
weekly.8: My fingers are coming 🖐 I started counting: 1, 2, 3… shall I count again?
weekly.9: I have tiny muscles now 💪 I'm working out in secret
weekly.10: My nails are starting to grow 💅 We'll talk about manicures later
weekly.12: I put my thumb in my mouth today 👍 Yummy!
weekly.13: I've got my fingerprints now ☝️ I'm one of a kind!
weekly.14: I'm practising faces: a frown, a smile… 😄
weekly.15: I can sense light ☀️ I'm going to love sunny days!
weekly.16: My eyes are moving slowly 👀 Still closed, but it's exciting
weekly.17: I'm storing a little fat for my cheeks 😊 For kisses!
weekly.18: My ears are ready 👂 Getting ready to hear your voice
weekly.19: I'm learning somersaults 🤸 Did you feel it?
weekly.20: We're halfway there! 🎉 I clapped for myself today
weekly.21: My kicks are getting stronger 🦶 That means “hi”!
weekly.22: My eyebrows came in 🤨 Now I'm more expressive
weekly.23: I'm listening to music 🎶 I loved your song
weekly.24: I'm practising breathing 🌬 Still underwater, but I'm a pro!
weekly.25: My hair is growing 💇 The colour will be a surprise!
weekly.26: I can open my eyes! 👀 Everything looks pink in here
weekly.28: I can blink 😉 That's me winking at you
weekly.29: Space is getting tight, but I'm still dancing 💃
weekly.30: I'm getting smarter every day 🧠 Just like you!
weekly.31: I can turn my head ↔️ I look towards your voice
weekly.32: My nails reach my fingertips 💅 Getting ready!
weekly.33: I'm getting stronger every day 💪 Getting ready for cuddles
weekly.34: My cheeks are getting chubby 😊 Ready for kisses
weekly.35: It's so cosy in here 🙈 I need somewhere to put my feet
weekly.36: I'm almost ready! Just the finishing touches ✨
weekly.37: My eyes, my ears, my heart: they're all waiting for you 💛
weekly.38: I'm dreaming of your arms 🤗 Not long now
weekly.39: Have you packed your bag? 😄 I'm ready
weekly.40: Could be today, could be tomorrow 😄 I'll surprise you!
weekly.41: It's so comfy in here, can I stay a little longer? 🙈💛

daily: Today I'm the size of a {fruit}! I'm growing 🌱
It's warm and cosy in here, don't worry 😌
Rest a little today, I'll rest too 😴
Don't forget to drink water, I like it too 💧
Smile, mum! When you smile, I relax too 😊
Say hi to dad for me! 👋
I'm little, but I love you so much 💛
I grew a little today, did you feel it? 📏
I love you a little more every day 🥰
Will you tell me a story? 📖
I'm waiting for you, and you're waiting for me 🤗
